items.title: Lesson Podcast
items.description: Audio walkthrough of what AR is, the five sectors that use it, three types of AR, and the devices that bring it to life.

items.title: How computers learn to recognize objects instantly — Joseph Redmon TED
items.description: AR depends on real-time object recognition — this TED talk explains the computer vision that makes AR overlay possible.

items.title: 100+ Computer Science Concepts Explained — Fireship
items.description: Fireship covers AR, VR and mixed reality concepts rapidly — good orientation before diving into the technical detail.

items.title: The ethical dilemma of self-driving cars — Patrick Lin TED
items.description: AR in transport is one of the five sectors — this TED talk explores the real stakes of AR-assisted driving systems.

items.title: Ready Player One (2018)
items.description: Spielberg's dazzling portrayal of immersive AR and VR — perfect inspiration for understanding what AR can become.

items.title: CoSpaces Edu — Build AR & 3D Scenes in Your Browser
items.description: Free browser-based tool to create AR and 3D scenes — used in many schools for exactly the kind of prototype you will build in Unit 3.

items.title: OCR Cambridge Nationals IT — Specification at a Glance
items.description: Review exactly what OCR expects on AR purpose, types and devices in the Unit 3 section of the J836 spec.
